review_process: Parent source/diff review and separately prompted read-only gpt-5.6-sol/ultra source_pox, representation_pox and adversarial_pox. Findings below adjudicated; final immutable-head review recorded in Git-local receipt. Correlated computation, not independent human or laboratory validation.
source_inspection: Four retained publisher witnesses hash checked. SI printed pp8-9 (PDF pp9-10) equations9-12 and schemes visually inspected; Results p4 used only with assay qualification; ED Table2b WT row/footnotes i-k; ED Figure8 and Figure7a legends; Data Availability. No new scientific-source acquisition.

adjudications.objection: A multistep FAD-reduction reporter cannot supply one elementary arrow rate.
adjudications.decision: Preserve source Michaelis-to-covalent reversibility and subsequent processing; attach k_app_max to the two-transition observed phase. Leave every individual pyruvate rate slot unassigned; bind K_0.5 at fit scope while n remains in the source equation.
adjudications.evidence: SI printed p9 scheme, prose and equations11-12; ED Table2b footnote j.

adjudications.objection: MAP association and pyruvate processing share a study but differ in ligand, reporter and kinetic order.
adjudications.decision: Separate source-bound ligand branches; MAP k_on second order and k_off first order. K_D_app stays the source-derived apparent equilibrium including the covalent conjugate.
adjudications.evidence: SI printed p8 scheme/equations9-10; ED Table2b footnote i; Figure8a-f legends.

adjudications.objection: The original model consumer requires a deposit even when the source-model relation is supported without one.
adjudications.decision: Add an explicit absent arrangement with a nonempty reason and no atom/arrangement bindings. Retain all existing TKT source/deposit checks when present. 6HAF is E59Q+phosphate; 4FEG is a source-named WT carbanion-enamine locator without a retained arrangement or assay-preparation identity.
adjudications.evidence: Data Availability; ED Figure7a legend; current retained packet inventory.

adjudications.objection: Inventing original observation IDs would disguise reused table parameters as new evidence.
adjudications.decision: Allow projected-only endpoints only with existing observation, exact parameter, assay, study and construct references. All five original parameters stay unchanged; the numeric Hill coefficient remains in the original provider, outside this five-parameter relation.
adjudications.evidence: Unchanged POX functional provider and current projection.

adjudications.objection: Mutation review accepted an unreferenced extra transition rate, relabelled kinetic order or elementary role, and a different enzyme under the same DOI.
adjudications.decision: Require exact one-to-one bound-direction endpoint coverage, complete typed kinetic roles/units, generic fit-role dimensional contracts, source enzyme binding and ligand/assay agreement. Reject those observed failure modes with focused mutation cases. The same coverage guard protects the existing TKT cleavage boundary.
adjudications.evidence: Adversarial in-memory mutations before the fix; final rejection tests and immutable review in receipt.

adjudications.objection: A wild-type model could be promoted into E59Q MAP-state evidence.
adjudications.decision: Scope this link to WT; retain all five other variants and E59Q unavailability/positive-pyruvate observations without change. No new variant state or measurement follows.
adjudications.evidence: ED Table2b WT/E59Q rows and original POX packet.

adjudications.objection: An unprojected contextual Hill coefficient could be switched to another variant without an endpoint-level construct check.
adjudications.decision: Remove the unnecessary contextual scalar binding and require every fit parameter to have exactly one existing projected endpoint. Keep the source equation n and original provider unchanged; no new construct/group adapter is built for an unneeded scalar.
adjudications.evidence: Representation reviewer changed the WT contextual pointer to H89N and the candidate accepted it; a regression now rejects that injection.

adjudications.objection: A coherent rewrite of source states, directional slots, units, roles and endpoint declarations can remain internally consistent.
adjudications.decision: Treat this as replacement of source semantics requiring primary-source review, not a validation of chemical truth. The public consumer pins the complete reviewed context and rejects unreviewed byte changes. No enzyme-ID/state-ID code or duplicate source-truth assertion is added.
adjudications.evidence: Representation compound direction swap; current source directions independently checked against SI schemes. Existing public reviewed-binding tamper tests establish the mechanical boundary.
